headline: "Flag bearer" returns with fanfare: can it be sustained? Strong earnings growth and "real money" support confidence; institutions point to excess opportunities in brokerages
summary: On August 26, the Shanghai Composite Index regained the 3,900 level as the brokerage sector surged, with Jinlong Shares and Xiangcai Shares hitting limit-up quickly.
why: The Shanghai Composite is the benchmark index for China's largest exchange, and brokerages are sensitive to trading volumes and market sentiment.

impacts.name: Shanghai Composite Index
impacts.why: The index regained the 3,900 level on the rally.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The input links the rally to the return of the 'flag bearer' (national team) and strong earnings growth and 'real money' support, with brokerages leading gains.
